title: Canadian Cream Pudding Parfait
description: A layered dessert made with Canadian cream, pudding, and biscuits. Perfect for a sweet treat.
instructions: Crush the Oreos and set aside.
Cut the jumbo biscuits into small squares.
In a separate bowl, mix the Canadian cream with the pudding until well combined.
In a glass or parfait dish, create a layer of biscuits, followed by a layer of the pudding mixture.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of biscuits on top.
Sprinkle the crushed Oreos over the top layer of biscuits.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Slice into individual servings and serve chilled.
Enjoy your delicious Canadian cream pudding parfait!
